system.notes:
Seafoam-green aquatic dragonkin with a shark head and a long, ribbony eel-like body. Powerful but dumb.

AC 14, HP 39, ATK 2 bite +7 (3d6 + swallow), MV double near (swim), S +6, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +4, AL C, LV 8

Impossible Leap. Jump up to far in height and double near in distance, then make 2 bite attacks.

Mariner's Misfortune. Non- aquatic mortals within near, CHA 15+ or cursed with bad luck, rolling checks and attacks with DISADV for 1d4 rounds. On success, immune for 24 hours.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 19-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round. Cetus regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
